name: SK-GEC
description: Dataset, code and results for the paper "Fine-Tuning the Slovak T5 Base Model for Spelling Correction Using Artificially Corrupted Data" (Acta Electrotechnica et Informatica). The archive contains: (1) SK-GEC datasets with 1M and 5M Slovak sentences in two corruption variants - 100% (one word corrupted in every sentence) and 15% (random 15% of sentences corrupted); CSV with columns "correct" and "incorrect"; (2) training, inference and evaluation code (Hugging Face Transformers, SLURM) for fine-tuning TUKE-KEMT/slovak-t5-base; (3) evaluation results, model outputs on the test sets, data-leakage and error analyses. Errors are synthetic character-level substitutions (e.g. y/i, s/š, ie/je). See README.md in the archive for details and reproduction instructions.
